content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Salesforce Products ## slug: salesforce-products ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End If you already have or want to track {{variable.Object_Event}} Tickets with standard Products, we have added a lookup to products on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} object with a process that pulls over the product's information to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} record. ## Initial Setup Update the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} page layout with the product fields, {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Product}} and {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PriceBook}}. ![salesforce products](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/salesforce%20products.png){height="" width=""} ## Set the Product and Price Book If you just define the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Product}} field, the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Description}}, {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}}, and {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PriceBook}} (standard price book) fields will be set. If you define the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Product}} and {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PriceBook}} fields, the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Description}}, {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} (from the defined price book), and {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PriceBook}} will be set. ![Salesforce Products and Event Items](https://youtu.be/NdGLo3AxnGM){height="480" width="640"}
